title: Mixed Duo #031 · 여 바이올린 힙 아워글래스·BollywoodGlam / 남 클래식 머슬·그래픽 블랙
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny green meadow full of wildflowers with a dirt path, a wooden fence and gate of normal height, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Indian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead square-sided cowbell, an iron cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop with a heavy rough tin a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre hanging at its end, and a single platinum bracelet. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Jamaican man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, pure icy-white hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
